bio.text: Maxwell Frost represents Florida's 10th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is described by his office as the first member of Generation Z elected to Congress.
He was born on January 17, 1997, and worked as an organizer, including at the ACLU and as National Organizing Director of March For Our Lives, before running for office.
According to his official biography, as a high school student he was band leader of a salsa band based at the Osceola County School for the Arts.
